judge.rationale: The candidate's implementation is completely sound and directly addresses every acceptance criterion in the issue. Rather than merely renaming the parameter to `totalUsage` like the reference did, the candidate introduced and exported a structurally identical `AggregatedUsageMetadata` interface in `src/types/ai.ts`, which arguably satisfies the ticket's prompt to make 'The type of what the hook receives... unambiguous' even more literally (and matches `src/types/ai.ts` being listed in Key files). The core `accumulateUsage` logic in `chatOrchestrator.ts` is identical to the reference. Slight differences from the reference include placing the new acceptance tests in a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree) and keeping the new `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` bullet under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section rather than moving it up into the main spec body.
